text: Copper is the only CRM built specifically for Google Workspace, making it the most seamless and powerful option for sending an email series directly from Gmail. You can create multi-step outreach workflows, personalize messages with merge fields, and track every click, and reply, all without leaving your inbox. It replaces bulky tools and disconnected extensions with a single, streamlined solution. Combined with AI writing, real-time analytics, integrations, and native Gmail functionality, Copper gives you everything you need to scale outreach and build stronger relationships at scale.
